標題： 【轉知】AASP the 12th conference (2025/8/2 - 8/4) in NPU Japan
日期： Wed, 26 Mar 2025 16:20:31 +0800
附檔： AASP 2025.pdf (2 MB)   
AASP (Asian Association of Schools of Pharmacy) the 12th conference will be hosted by Nihon Pharmaceutical University (NPU) from August 2 to 4, 2025 in NPU saitama campus. It will be the virgin tour for the conference of AASP in Japan, in the meantime, AASP the 25th anniversary will be celebrated. Very honored by above opportunity, many experts and the VIP guests from Japan and Asia Pacific will attend and give their excellent presentations.

REGISTRATION:
https://smartconf.jp/content/aasp2025/registration

CALL FOR PAPERS:
https://smartconf.jp/content/aasp2025/callforpapers

SPONSOR:
https://smartconf.jp/content/aasp2025/sponsor

Importance:
Early-bird discount before the end of May.
Abstract submission before the end of May.

For the students of NPU Summer Program A (PG-A: 2025/07/28 - 08/08 as mentioned in our previous email), they will be the free audiences without registration (but merely watch) for AASP the 12th conference from 8/2 to 8/3 (excluding lunch, banquet and tour).

For the mentor who wants to participate, and for the student who hopes to make an academic presentation, please register via the above homepages (covering lunch, banquet and tour).
We are expecting the students and mentors as more as possible from our global partners to join and present their best in this upcoming carnival of international pharmacy.
